Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).
Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin_bio:
Lanaya, the Templar Assassin, came to her calling by a path of curious inquiry. Possessed of a scientific bent, she spent her early years engaged in meticulous study of nature's laws--peering into grimoires of magic and alchemy, recreating experiments from charred fragments of the Violet Archives, and memorizing observations of the Keen recordkeepers. Already quiet and secretive by nature, the difficulty of acquiring these objects further reinforced her skills of stealth. Had she been less retiring, she might have become notorious among the guilds as a thief-scholar. Instead her investigations led her into far more obscure corners.

As she devoted her furtive talents to unlocking the secrets of the universe, she instead unlocked a secret door that exists in nature itself: the entryway to the most Hidden Temple. The intelligences that waited beyond that portal, proved to be expecting her, and whatever mysteries they revealed in the moment of their discovery was nothing compared to the answers they held out to Lanaya should she continue in their service. She swore to protect the mysteries, but more to the point, in service to the Hidden Temple she satisfies her endless craving for understanding. In the eyes of each foe she expunges, a bit more of the mystery is revealed.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Interrupts Lanaya's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.

* The ability has three main components:
** All components applied are upon cast, and are indepedent of each other.
** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*** The ability effects are visible to everyone.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|templar_assassin_refraction_absorb}} {{to}} {{Symbol|bonus db-all}}
*** Grants a unique all [[damage barrier]] per instance with the following properties:
**** When {{Code|DmgInst ≥ {{#var:Refraction value2}} or Remainder}}, the damage instance, including {{M|HP Removal}} sources, applied is negated.
**** Grants a new barrier instance whenever the previous barrier is depleted as long as there are instances left.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|templar_assassin_refraction_damage}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Bonus}}
*** Grants the [[unique bonus attack damage]] as follows:
***# Applies the bonus attack damage upon a successful attack, despite the values being displayed on the [[HUD]].
***#* Does not grants the bonus attack damage in the following conditions:
***#** Attacking {{M|allied units|x}}.
***#** {{M|Disjointed}} attacks.
***#** While an attack projectile is traveling upon cast. However, the ability still consumes an attack charge upon a successful attack.
***# Reduces 1 bonus attack damage charge.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]]
*** {{cf|shdnotes}} Now enables Refraction to be cast while being {{M|disabled}}, except when affected by the following sources:
**** While Lanaya {{M|cannot act}}.
**** {{M|Hex}} sources.
**** {{M|Silence}} sources.
**** Lanaya can no longer {{M|shift-queue}} this ability upon acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Shard|text=ability upgrade}}.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** The ability effects are applied on Lanaya as follows upon cast:
**# {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|templar_assassin_meld}}
**#* Grants the following bonuses {{Code|indefinitely}} upon cast:
**#** {{M|Invisibility}}
**#** {{M|Phase movement}}.
**#* The buff disappears in the following conditions:
**#** Upon issued a move command.
**#** Upon reaching the {{M|cast point}} of abilities, including item abilities.
**#** Upon a successful attack.
**#** {{M|Forced movement}} sources moving Lanaya on the x-axis.
**#* The buff persists in the following conditions:
**#** {{M|turn rate|text=Turning around}}.
**#** Pick up, drop or attack {{M|items}}.
**#** {{M|Teleport}} sources, including upon {{A|Templar Assassin|Psionic Projection}} cast.
**#** {{M|Upward movement}} sources moving Lanaya on the z-axis.
**# Issues a stop order.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The next successful attack on a unit applies the ability effects as follows:
**# {{Symbol|Invisible}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}}
**#* After launching an attack [[projectile]], Lanaya can perform any action without losing {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|templar_assassin_meld}}, the {{M|invisibility}} buff.
**#** However, the buff is immediately dispelled in the following conditions:
**#*** Upon the attack projectile being {{M|disjointed}}
**#*** Upon the attack instance {{M|missed}}.
**# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|templar_assassin_meld_armor}}
**#* Each instance applies a new debuff on the attacked target, with each debuff duration instance independent of the other.
**# The flat {{#var:Meld type1 value1}} {{M|physical}} {{M|attack damage}} instance.
**#* This ability component neither procs {{M|attack modifiers}} nor interacts with {{A|Templar Assassin|Psi Blades}}.
**# {{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{Symbol|Bash}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|[[bash]]ed}}
**# Lanaya's attack instance with the {{A|Templar Assassin|Psi Blades}} instance, if applicable.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin
data.bio_loc:
Lanaya, the Templar Assassin, came to her calling by a path of curious inquiry. Possessed of a scientific bent, she spent her early years engaged in meticulous study of nature's laws--peering into grimoires of magic and alchemy, recreating experiments from charred fragments of the Violet Archives, and memorizing observations of the Keen recordkeepers. Already quiet and secretive by nature, the difficulty of acquiring these objects further reinforced her skills of stealth. Had she been less retiring, she might have become notorious among the guilds as a thief-scholar. Instead her investigations led her into far more obscure corners.

As she devoted her furtive talents to unlocking the secrets of the universe, she instead unlocked a secret door that exists in nature itself: the entryway to the most Hidden Temple. The intelligences that waited beyond that portal, proved to be expecting her, and whatever mysteries they revealed in the moment of their discovery was nothing compared to the answers they held out to Lanaya should she continue in their service. She swore to protect the mysteries, but more to the point, in service to the Hidden Temple she satisfies her endless craving for understanding. In the eyes of each foe she expunges, a bit more of the mystery is revealed.
data.hype_loc: Peppering the battlefield with slowing traps, Templar Assassin hides invisibly, ready to ambush her prey. Once she springs her attack, she shreds enemies with piercing psionic blades, and deflects counterattacks with her refracting shield.

abilities.name: templar_assassin_refraction
abilities.desc_loc: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
abilities.lore_loc: Manipulating her psionic veil, Lanaya bends nature's law to her will.
notes_loc: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).
abilities.shard_loc: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.

abilities.name: templar_assassin_meld
abilities.desc_loc: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for %debuff_duration% seconds. Bonus damage and debuffs from Meld are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
abilities.lore_loc: Lanaya is as elusive as her covenant with the Hidden Temple.
notes_loc: Meld is broken by any action other than staying in position or channeling Psionic Projection.
Meld's armor reduction does not work against towers.
facets_loc: Meld bonus damage and armor reductions are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
When in Meld, Templar increases her attack range by up to an additional %attack_range_increase_max% range over %attack_range_increase_time%s.

abilities.name: templar_assassin_psi_blades
abilities.desc_loc: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.
abilities.lore_loc: Her blades pierce the skin as much as the mind, furthering her understanding of the mystery that is reality.
notes_loc: Attack effects like Bash will only be applied to the main target.

abilities.name: templar_assassin_trap_teleport
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for %abilitychanneltime% seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing %extra_damage% bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.
abilities.lore_loc: In reward for her service, Lanaya has been granted access to secrets that unlock new techniques for her psionic gifts.

abilities.name: templar_assassin_psionic_trap
abilities.desc_loc: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of %movement_speed_min%%% in a %trap_radius% radius. Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds. Deals damage after %trap_max_charge_duration%s.
abilities.lore_loc: Calling upon the reach of the Hidden Temple, none escape the eye of the Templar.
notes_loc: They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.
abilities.scepter_loc: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.

abilities.name: templar_assassin_inner_peace
abilities.desc_loc: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for %time_until_meditation%s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after %time_until_max_bonus%s of meditating.

talents.desc_loc: Applies a basic dispel to Templar Assassin.
